name: Auguste Renoir
findings: Within his own canvases, spruce green turns up as a small accent in 60% of the paintings that hold it, 3.9x the archive's rate (from 2886 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, mountbatten pink turns up as the lightest note in 76% of the paintings that hold it, 2.5x the archive's rate (from 2886 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, maroon turns up as the shadow in 88% of the paintings that hold it, 3.4x the archive's rate (from 2886 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 2886 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 2886 paintings here).
Pairs saddle brown with windsor tan more than chance would predict (3 of 2886 paintings here).
Pairs mahogany with morocco red more than chance would predict (3 of 2886 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (smoky black, white, raisin black) covers 56% of his paintings here.
